paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The evaluation of inference methods using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. Length: prefill length + generation length. Bsz: batch size. KV mem.: GPU memory usage (GB) of the KV cache. Thr.: throughput (token/s) : S_r ratio ablation study.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between recent sequence ratio and perplexity and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 100 with tick labels at intervals of 20. The primary y-axis on the left is labeled “Perplexity” and uses a linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The secondary y-axis on the right is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale from 40 to 100 with tick labels at intervals of 10. A solid orange line with circular markers represents “Perplexity”, starting at approximately 4.28 at a recent sequence ratio of 0, declining to 4.22 at a ratio of 60, and then increasing to 4.63 at a ratio of 100. A dashed brown line represents “Full Cache PPL,” beginning at approximately 4.62 at a recent sequence ratio of 0 and remaining relatively steady at around 4.47 throughout the range, reaching 4.49 at a ratio of 100. A solid blue line with circular markers represents “GPU Mem. Ratio”, starting at approximately 41 at a recent sequence ratio of 0 and increasing to approximately 95 at a ratio of 100. A dashed teal line represents “Full Cache GPU Mem. Ratio,” starting at approximately 63 at a recent sequence ratio of 0 and remaining relatively steady at around 61 throughout the range, increasing to 64 at a ratio of 100.
